title: Change exposes an unsteady expectation
meaning: Practical flexibility in pursuit of mutual involvement can accompany a sharp emotional discovery that a familiar expectation lacked a dependable foundation.
text: In this pair’s Energy Field, the Wheel of Fortune in the physical position concerns changing shared actions when conditions no longer remain the same. The Lovers in energy provide a motive to seek mutuality and living involvement in each other. The Tower in emotions indicates the shock of an unreliable assumption breaking down. A wish to be together can remain, even as an unexpected change exposes how little confirmation supported your picture of a shared agreement.

For example, a cancelled train makes you reconsider the weekend. During the discussion, it emerges that one person has wanted a quiet rest for some time, while the other assumed an active trip was a shared dream. You look for another option, but the discovery itself hurts. **We want to be together, yet our picture of the other person’s wish was unsteady.** The emotional impact concerns a fallen certainty; new tickets cannot remove it by themselves.

The difficulty intensifies if wanting mutuality becomes a demand to restore the previous picture immediately. Any new arrangement is then used to avoid acknowledging the shock. Another possibility is a hasty conclusion that a mistaken expectation cancels all closeness. The Tower does not promise that an exposed crack will automatically prove beneficial, and the collapse of an assumption does not by itself establish either person’s blame.
